tokens.label: Ticks per second at 1x
tokens.doc: How many ticks 1x plays per second. The site plays 500 ms per tick (2 ticks per second); the speed buttons multiply this.

tokens.label: Simulation step rate
tokens.doc: The clock advances in exact steps of 1/rate seconds; the renderer interpolates between steps. Independent of the display refresh rate.

tokens.label: Longest frame the clock accepts
tokens.doc: A frame longer than this (a stalled or hidden tab) advances the clock by this much only, so the battle cannot fast-forward after a stall.

tokens.label: Speed ease time
tokens.doc: Play, pause and speed changes ease in and out over about this time (0 = instant).

tokens.label: Seek glide time
tokens.doc: A seek or a jump to a scene flies the clock to the target with a critically damped glide of this time constant instead of teleporting.

tokens.label: Seek glide speed cap
tokens.doc: The glide never flies faster than this, so a long jump is a fly-through of the interpolated paths, not a blur.

tokens.label: At the end of the battle
tokens.doc: What happens when playback reaches the last tick.

tokens.label: Clock model
tokens.doc: RESEARCH. The production loop adds the frame time to a per-tick accumulator and draws the tick read at the START of the frame with the fraction of the current one: on the frame in which the tick advances it draws the old tick with the new fraction, so interpolating units step back for one frame (report 01, 6.3). Pair it with a smooth motion model to see that bug alone.

tokens.label: Motion model
tokens.doc: How a unit moves between its own keyframes. All models are exact at every keyframe; between keyframes the position is Modelled.

tokens.label: Start and stop
tokens.doc: Whether a unit's track starts and ends at rest (eased) or with the velocity of its first and last segment.

tokens.label: Strength bar tween
tokens.doc: When a unit's current keyframe changes its strength, the bar eases to the new value over this time. The value itself is the keyframe's, never interpolated into numbers that are not in the data.

tokens.label: Layout strategy
tokens.doc: Which layout module places the tiles. certified guarantees zero overlap; raw is a diagnostic that shows the unsolved problem.

tokens.label: Which units are on the map

options.label: Carry forward (what the site draws today)

tokens.doc: The visibility rule decides how many tiles exist at all (typical 384 under carry-forward, 44 under a window, 7 under the snapshot; 03-data-fuel.md section 9.1).

tokens.label: Fresh window
tokens.doc: Under the window rule a unit is shown only within this many ticks before or after one of its own keyframes.

tokens.label: Displacement budget
tokens.doc: How far a tile may sit from its true position so it can be read (a pin and a leader line stay on the true position). 0 = pure aggregation. Beyond the budget the tile is merged into an aggregate.

tokens.label: Reach at close zoom
tokens.doc: How far a mark may stand from its true position once the camera is close (from the zoom below): two records are not merged into a crowd while there is free ground within this reach. The pin and the leader keep the true position.

tokens.label: Reach grows from zoom
tokens.doc: The reach grows from the first-prototype budget at this zoom, smoothly, to the close reach at the next dial.

tokens.label: Reach full at zoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a mark may stand the close reach from its true position.

tokens.label: Clearance between tiles
tokens.doc: Minimum free space between any two tile boxes.

tokens.label: Split hysteresis band
tokens.doc: An aggregate tries to split only when its members would fit within the budget minus this band, so it does not flicker.

tokens.label: Return speed
tokens.doc: How fast a displaced tile drifts back toward its true position when there is room.

tokens.label: Aggregate dwell
tokens.doc: An aggregate exists at least this long before a split is tried (merge now, split later).

tokens.label: Label show delay
tokens.doc: A name label may appear only after it has fitted for this long (it disappears at once when it stops fitting).

tokens.label: Label cool-down
tokens.doc: After a name label is hidden (something took its place) it may not come back for this long, so a label does not blink while tiles jostle.

tokens.label: Labels from zoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit whose full name fits in the free ground beside it lets the name grow out of its code. The hovered or selected unit grows its name at any zoom.

tokens.label: Zoom of the codes
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit shows its short code in the free ground beside its disc (right, else left); below it the discs are bare, so a crowd opens as soon as the discs fit and the opening view stays quiet. The hovered or selected unit shows its name at any zoom.

tokens.label: Neighbourhood cap
tokens.doc: A neighbourhood with more obstacles than this is declared saturated and the tile aggregates (a conservative failure: never an overlap).

tokens.label: Protect true positions
tokens.doc: No tile may cover another tile's true position.

tokens.label: Name labels
tokens.doc: Show the secondary name labels where they fit.

tokens.label: Where a name may grow

options.label: Right of the mark (the text run goes on)
Right, left, below, above (the first prototype)

tokens.doc: The free slots a name may take around its mark, in order. A name that grows out of the mark continues its text run, so only the right is natural.

tokens.label: Continuity radius
tokens.doc: EXPERIMENT. A tile that already has a place never jumps farther than this from it in one frame: when the only free place is farther it merges into an aggregate instead. Measured to multiply aggregate churn by ten at 14 px (see README), so it is off; the display layer travels instead. 0 = off.

tokens.label: Solve cadence
tokens.doc: How often the certified layout is re-solved. In between, the solved tiles move with their units (same offsets, new true positions) and every displayed frame is still verified. Automatic raises it when frames run long on a slow device and lowers it again when there is room.

tokens.label: Split trials per frame
tokens.doc: At most this many aggregates try to split in one frame.

tokens.label: Display dynamics
tokens.doc: dynamics = smooth glide with collision-aware pushing; spring = smooth glide only; snap = show the layout as solved (the lab behaviour, for comparison).

tokens.label: Glide time
tokens.doc: Time constant of the glide that carries a tile to its newly solved position.

tokens.label: Glide speed cap
tokens.doc: A displaced tile never glides faster than this.

tokens.label: Travel distance
tokens.doc: A tile whose solved place is farther than this from where it stands does not push its way there: it dims below 0.5 opacity, glides through, and solidifies on arrival, so it neither obscures nor is obscured on the way.

tokens.label: Travel glide time
tokens.doc: Glide time constant of a dimmed travelling tile.

tokens.label: Travel opacity
tokens.doc: Opacity of a travelling tile; must stay below 0.5, the opacity rule's threshold between solid and not solid.

tokens.label: Largest push
tokens.doc: A contact moves a tile by at most this much per pass, so tiles are eased apart instead of shoved (the first prototype used 1.5: with four passes that is up to 6 px in a frame, and where contacts compound a visible hop). Measured on 600 frames of three scenes at 1x and 4x with tools/jitter-probe.mjs: 0.75 halves the hops at 4x in the Wheatfield (about 6 to 2) at no cost in overlaps (the safety net still guarantees none). What still overlaps is repaired by dimming, never by overlap.

tokens.label: Collision passes
tokens.doc: Passes of the pushing solver per frame.

tokens.label: Fade time
tokens.doc: Duration of a tile's fade in or out. Two tiles that hand over to each other never both have opacity of 0.5 or more at once.

tokens.label: Birth size
tokens.doc: Size of a mark at birth, as a share of its final size (it grows to 100 percent while it fades in; the disc adds a small settle inside its own box).

tokens.label: Label fade time
tokens.doc: How long a name takes to wipe out of its mark (and to go back).

tokens.label: Cross-fade time of a cut
tokens.doc: When the picture changes too much for a glide (a jump in time or zoom) the old tiles fade out and the new ones fade in, in sequence.

tokens.label: Zoom jump that cuts
tokens.doc: A zoom change larger than this in one frame is a cut (cross-fade) instead of a glide.

tokens.label: Time jump that cuts
tokens.doc: A tick change larger than this in one frame is a cut (cross-fade) instead of a glide.

tokens.label: Safety net
tokens.doc: Every displayed frame is verified; of two solid tiles that would still overlap the lighter one is dimmed below 0.5 and travels to its certified place (counted). Turn off only to measure how often it fires.

tokens.label: Reduced motion
tokens.doc: Reduced motion lands seeks at once and shows the layout as solved, with short fades.

tokens.label: Zoom
tokens.doc: Map zoom (Mapbox 512 px world). The site opens at 13.5; desktop views are clamped to 12.04 or more.

tokens.label: Zoom glide
tokens.doc: Wheel zoom glides with this time constant.

tokens.label: Pan glide
tokens.doc: Camera moves (scene jumps) glide with this time constant.

tokens.label: Lowest zoom
tokens.doc: Lowest zoom the Studio allows.

tokens.label: Highest zoom
tokens.doc: Highest zoom the Studio allows (the site's maximum is 18).

tokens.label: Leader lines
tokens.doc: A thin line from a displaced mark to the place it truly stands (drawn only when that place is clear of the mark).

tokens.label: True-position pins
tokens.doc: Draw a pin on the true position of every displaced tile.

tokens.label: Hulls on interaction
tokens.doc: On hover or selection, show the soft hull of the formation the mark belongs to (or of the crowd it stands for) and the true position of each record.

tokens.label: Click tolerance
tokens.doc: Extra pixels around a tile that still count as a click on it.

tokens.label: Skin
tokens.doc: The skin that draws the marks. Dispatch (art direction 4): one mark per unit, a haloed code beside a bold disc or standard, the name growing out of the mark, formation hulls on interaction.

tokens.label: Last-fix age channel
tokens.doc: Reference skin: dim and dash the outline of a tile whose latest keyframe is old, so a carried-forward tile does not look like a fresh report (03-data-fuel.md).

tokens.label: Backdrop
tokens.doc: The ground: the real USGS aerial photograph (NAIP, April to May 2022), lit by the 3DEP elevation model, with contours and TIGER roads; four looks. It is modern ground, not the 1863 landscape.

tokens.label: Grid spacing
tokens.doc: Spacing of the metric grid.

tokens.label: Place names
tokens.doc: Show the place names of the site data (the skin draws them; a name steps aside for a mark that would cover it).

tokens.label: Metrics overlay
tokens.doc: Show frame times, motion, overlap and solve cost live.

tokens.label: History length
tokens.doc: Frames kept for the graphs and the export.

tokens.label: Pop threshold
tokens.doc: A tile that moves more than this beyond its true position's own motion in one frame counts as a pop (the lab definition).

tokens.label: Verify every frame
tokens.doc: Run the independent overlap verifier on every displayed frame (about 0.2 ms).

tokens.label: Renderer
tokens.doc: Replays the same ticks through the shipped tile renderer, reproduced from report 01 (bars, per-tick stepping with the stale-tick bug, hold-then-jump keyframes, the from-scratch relaxation that leaves tiles overlapping), or through the Studio. Your own settings are kept while the production dials are laid over them. Positions and strengths stay Modelled in both.

tokens.label: Popups
tokens.doc: Master switch of every popup. Off hides all cards, chips, the rail and the Chronicle strip; the map is unchanged.

tokens.label: Enter time
tokens.doc: A card arrives with a decelerating curve over this time. One motion language for every popup (02-popups.md rule 7: 220 ms in, 160 ms out).

tokens.label: Exit time
tokens.doc: A card leaves with an accelerating curve over this time; shorter than the enter so leaving never holds the viewer up.

tokens.label: Relocation: fade out
tokens.doc: A card whose place is being taken by tiles fades out where it was for this long. It never glides across the map, so it never passes over a tile.

tokens.label: Relocation: fade in
tokens.doc: ...and fades in at its new, free place over this time.

tokens.label: Enter rise
tokens.doc: A card rises this far while it fades in. Kept under the clear gap so the moving card never touches a tile; 0 = fade only. Reduced motion always uses 0.

tokens.label: Leader draw time
tokens.doc: The line from a card to the tile it is about draws itself from the card to the tile over this time.

tokens.label: Subject ring pulse
tokens.doc: A ring on the subject tile grows and fades once when its card appears (0 = no pulse).

tokens.label: Chip arrival cue
tokens.doc: A chip in the strip shows its leader line to the subject tile for this long when it arrives, then only while hovered, focused or pinned (a permanent line from the dock across the map would be noise).

tokens.label: Occupancy grid cell
tokens.doc: Resolution of the free-space search. Finer cells find tighter gaps and cost more; the test is conservative either way (a touched cell counts as occupied).

tokens.label: Clear gap to tiles
tokens.doc: A card keeps at least this much clear ground around every chip, label, pin and aggregate dot (the vital core of a tile).

tokens.label: Screen margin
tokens.doc: A card keeps this far from the edges of the map.

tokens.label: Tiles that count as obstacles
tokens.doc: A tile at least this opaque is something a card must not cover. Lower than the layout's solid threshold (0.5) on purpose: a tile fading in or gliding past is about to be solid.

tokens.label: Distance from the subject
tokens.doc: How far from the subject tile a card is first tried.

tokens.label: Longest leader line
tokens.doc: A card whose nearest free place is farther than this from its subject is not floated: a chip in the strip with an arrival cue says it better than a line across the map. Cards with no chip form (tooltips, hints) ignore it.

tokens.label: Longest leader line drawn
tokens.doc: A leader line from a card to its subject is drawn only when it is at most this long. A longer one is left out: the subject stays highlighted and pulses, and the card names it.

tokens.label: Leader crossing penalty
tokens.doc: A candidate place whose leader line would cross another tile is judged this many pixels farther away per tile crossed. Leaders are drawn beneath tiles, so a crossing hides nothing, but a clean line reads better.

tokens.label: Stay-put pull
tokens.doc: When a card must move, a place near where it was is preferred by this weight against a place near the subject.

tokens.label: Relocation trigger
tokens.doc: A card whose clear ground to the nearest tile has shrunk below this starts a calm fade-relocation. A tile that actually touches it cuts it at once.

tokens.label: Form upgrade patience
tokens.doc: A card pushed down the ladder (full, compact, chip) tries the richer form again after things have been calm this long.

tokens.label: Critical cards alive at once
tokens.doc: How many tier A cards (critical events, stories) may be full or compact at once. A newer one turns the oldest into a chip: nothing is evicted, a chip never evicts a card.

tokens.label: High cards alive at once
tokens.doc: How many tier B cards (high events) may be compact at once; the rest are chips.

tokens.label: Floating cards at a time
tokens.doc: The most cards that may stand on the map at once (pinned cards and the hover tooltip excepted). The richest keeps the ground (the selection first, then the most important event); the others wait as chips in the Chronicle strip and nothing is lost.

tokens.label: Chips alive at once
tokens.doc: How many chips the Chronicle strip shows at once. Older chips leave the strip; their rows stay in the Chronicle.

tokens.label: Chip: shortest time on show
tokens.doc: A chip is not pushed out of the strip by newer ones before it has been on show this long (at 16x a new moment arrives every half second; the Chronicle keeps every row either way).

tokens.label: Full cards up to
tokens.doc: Up to this playback speed critical cards are full, high events compact. 02-popups.md 5.6: events arrive 24 per minute at 1x and 95 at 4x.

tokens.label: Compact cards up to
tokens.doc: Up to this speed critical cards are compact and high events chips; beyond it only critical cards remain, as chips.

tokens.label: Chips up to
tokens.doc: Beyond this speed no card is raised at all; the Chronicle still lists every row.

tokens.label: Reading speed
tokens.doc: Words per minute a card's lifetime assumes. 238 is the adult silent-reading figure of Brysbaert's meta-analysis as summarised by the BPS Research Digest (the paper itself was not opened); the product's own read time uses 200.

tokens.label: Critical card: base time
tokens.doc: Time a critical card is held before reading time is added.

tokens.label: Critical card: shortest life
tokens.doc: A critical card is never shorter than this, whatever its length (wall-clock, only while the battle plays).

tokens.label: Critical card: longest life
tokens.doc: A critical card never outstays this; a pinned card never expires.

tokens.label: High card: base time
tokens.doc: Time a high-significance card is held before reading time is added.

tokens.label: High card: shortest life
tokens.doc: Shortest life of a high-significance card.

tokens.label: High card: longest life
tokens.doc: Longest life of a high-significance card.

tokens.label: Chip: shortest life
tokens.doc: A chip stays at least this long in the strip.

tokens.label: Chip: longest life
tokens.doc: A chip never stays longer than this, and a card demoted to a chip is cut to it.

tokens.label: Landing delay
tokens.doc: After a seek or a step the clock must be still this long before the cards of the moment it landed on appear (scrubbing raises none).

tokens.label: Seek clears cards farther than
tokens.doc: When a seek begins, cards that belong to a moment farther than this from where it is going leave (pinned cards stay). 02-popups.md F-05: no stale toasts after a jump.

tokens.label: Dismissed card returns after
tokens.doc: A dismissed card comes back when the clock has moved this far from its moment (one day = 225), or at once from the Chronicle.

tokens.label: Screen-reader announcements
tokens.doc: At most one announcement per this time in the polite live region; when several cards arrive together one message names the most important and counts the rest.

tokens.label: Narrated mode

options.label: Slow down while a critical card is read
Slow down while any card is read

tokens.doc: While a card is being read the clock eases to a fraction of its speed and back, so a card can be read without pausing. Owner decision D-1 of 02-popups.md; off by default.

tokens.label: Narrated speed factor
tokens.doc: The playback speed is multiplied by this while a card is being read in Narrated mode.

tokens.label: Reading rail width
tokens.doc: Width of the docked reading panel. The map viewport shrinks by this much, the ground staying put, so reading never lies on a tile.

tokens.label: Rail open time
tokens.doc: Time the map takes to make room for the rail (and the phone sheet).

tokens.label: Phone sheet: peek height
tokens.doc: Height of the bottom sheet at its peek detent on a phone-sized screen: the head of the card and its first row, so the map keeps more than 60 percent of the screen.

tokens.label: Phone sheet: half height
tokens.doc: Height of the bottom sheet at its half detent as a share of the screen.

tokens.label: Phone layout below
tokens.doc: Below this screen width cards are chips in the lane and everything long opens in the bottom sheet (no free-standing cards: 02-popups.md 3.7 found no free ground on a phone).

tokens.label: Persistent popup return delay
tokens.doc: A clock, legend or overview that stepped aside for a tile comes back only after its place has been clear this long, so it does not flicker.

tokens.label: Palette
tokens.doc: Colour family of every popup. Colour is never the only cue: every tone also has a shape and a word.

tokens.label: Density
tokens.doc: Padding and line spacing of every card.

tokens.label: Corner radius
tokens.doc: Corner radius of every card (editorial: small).

tokens.label: Glass blur
tokens.doc: Backdrop blur behind a card (0: a card is paper, not glass).

tokens.label: Title face
tokens.doc: Typeface of story, tour and banner titles.

tokens.label: Text size
tokens.doc: Scales the type of every popup (13 px body at 1.0; 02-popups.md 5.8 asks for 13 px reading text and 11 px captions at least).

tokens.label: Elevation
tokens.doc: Shadow under cards: how far they stand off the map.

tokens.label: Event cards
tokens.doc: Show a card for each chronology event (134 events of significance critical, high or medium; 3 'low' rows are listed in the Chronicle only).

tokens.label: Full card width
tokens.doc: Width of the full event card (critical events at slow speeds). 02-popups.md measured tile-free ground for 460 x 150 in only 27 % of moments at the default zoom, so the ladder starts narrower.

tokens.label: Peek width
tokens.doc: Width of the event peek: the kicker, the first three lines of the sentence and the place. Tried when the full and compact cards find no free ground; the whole sentence is one click away (the tools button opens it in the reading panel).

tokens.label: Mini width
tokens.doc: Width of the smallest event card on the map: the kicker and two lines of the sentence. Below it only the chip in the strip remains.

tokens.label: Compact card width
tokens.doc: Width of the compact event card (the sentence, no narrative).

tokens.label: High-significance events
tokens.doc: How the 73 'high' events appear: a compact card (tier B) or only a chip. Tier B cards are shorter-lived than critical ones.

tokens.label: Medium-significance events
tokens.doc: How the 16 'medium' events appear. Never as a free-standing card.

tokens.label: Narrative note
tokens.doc: Where the italic narrative of the 25 events that have one is shown.

tokens.label: Landing window
tokens.doc: When the clock settles within this many ticks after an event, its card appears (the card of the moment you stopped on).

tokens.label: Keep the subject in view
tokens.doc: When an event card appears for a unit that is off-screen, pan the map just enough to bring it in. Off: an edge arrow points to it instead.

tokens.label: Story cards
tokens.doc: Show a card for each of the 24 vignettes when the clock reaches its trigger tick.

tokens.label: Peek width
tokens.doc: Width of the story peek: title, place, the first lines of the summary and 'Read the full story'.

tokens.label: Mini width
tokens.doc: Width of the smallest story card on the map: the title and one line of the summary. Below it only the chip in the strip remains.

tokens.label: Compact width
tokens.doc: Width of the compact story card (title and two lines).

tokens.label: Summary lines in the peek
tokens.doc: How many lines of the summary the peek shows before 'Read the full story'; the full summary and script are one action away.

tokens.label: Landing window
tokens.doc: A story is eligible for this many ticks after its trigger (the product uses 2).

tokens.label: Open the full story automatically

options.label: When the clock has stopped on it

tokens.doc: When to open the reading rail on a story without a click. Opening it never covers tiles: the map makes room.

tokens.label: Read-time estimate
tokens.doc: Words per minute of the '~N min read' label. The product uses 200; the reading budget of the card itself uses popup.read.wpm.

tokens.label: Command-change toasts
tokens.doc: Show a card for each of the 42 command changes (a general killed, wounded, captured, relieved, promoted, or arriving) when the clock reaches its tick.

tokens.label: Toast width
tokens.doc: Width of a command-change toast.

tokens.label: Merge changes within
tokens.doc: Command changes this close together become one card ('4 command changes', expandable); tick 550 alone has four.

tokens.label: Mini width
tokens.doc: Width of the smallest command-change card: the kind, the clock and the sentence. Below it only the chip in the strip remains.

tokens.label: Changes in one card
tokens.doc: At most this many command changes are merged into one card; the next one starts a new card (tick 550 has four, ticks 551 and 552 four more).

tokens.label: Show the source
tokens.doc: Show the per-row source of each command change (42 of 42 rows have one) as a Documented chip.

tokens.label: Which changes raise a toast
tokens.doc: Filter for fast playback. The Chronicle always lists all 42.

tokens.label: Commander cross-out
tokens.doc: Revived dead popup (02-popups.md P-04): when a command changes, the old commander's name is struck through on the unit's tile and the new name takes its place. Needs a free place next to the tile.

tokens.label: Time on the map
tokens.doc: How long the cross-out label stays (the product's dead card faded after 1.2 s and left at 3 s).

tokens.label: Strike after
tokens.doc: When the old name is struck through, after the label appears.

tokens.label: Width
tokens.doc: Width of the cross-out label.

tokens.label: Unit card and hover
tokens.doc: The hover tooltip (a dead popup revived, P-05) and the card of a selected unit (P-06): who, how strong, where it stands.

tokens.label: Hover delay
tokens.doc: A tile must be hovered this long before its tooltip appears. The tooltip stays while the pointer is on the tile or on it, and Esc dismisses it (WCAG 1.4.13).

tokens.label: Tooltip width
tokens.doc: Width of the hover tooltip.

tokens.label: Unit card width
tokens.doc: Width of the selected-unit card.

tokens.label: Recent positions
tokens.doc: How many of a unit's latest placement keyframes the unit card lists (Modelled: hand-authored positions).

tokens.label: Casualty figures
tokens.doc: Show the order-of-battle casualty total (Documented, secondary source: Busey and Martin as the file metadata claims; the source was not re-read here). Never drawn as a per-keyframe value.

tokens.label: Auto tour
tokens.doc: The 16-stop tour of the production site (P-07). Opens in the rail; the map flies to the stop and the subject is framed in the free part of the screen (the product's drawer hid its own subject).

tokens.label: Playback speed at a stop
tokens.doc: Speed the clock plays at during a stop (the product uses 2x).

tokens.label: Play time per tick of the window
tokens.doc: A stop plays its tick window for this long per tick, then pauses (the product: tickWindow x 250 ms).

tokens.label: Restore the speed on close
tokens.doc: Closing the tour puts the playback speed back as it was.

tokens.label: Play each stop
tokens.doc: Play the stop's tick window after the map has flown there; off: the clock is set to the stop and stays paused.

tokens.label: Day banners
tokens.doc: A title card when the clock enters a new day or a new part of the day (dawn, dusk, night), from the clock module. The product has none (P-39).

tokens.label: Time on screen
tokens.doc: How long a banner stays (wall-clock, only while the battle plays).

tokens.label: Banner width
tokens.doc: Width of the banner ribbon.

tokens.label: Parts of the day
tokens.doc: Also announce night and dawn (from the candidate clock, labelled Modelled), not only the three days.

tokens.label: Clock badge
tokens.doc: The date, time and speed badge (P-10). It prints only what the clock module says: 'about 10:15 AM', always Modelled while the anchors are candidates.

tokens.label: Show the uncertainty
tokens.doc: Show the clock's stated uncertainty (plus or minus minutes, interpolated from the anchors' own estimates).

tokens.label: Day progress ring
tokens.doc: A ring for how much of the day's ticks have passed (Computed from the three tick ranges).

tokens.label: Home
tokens.doc: Where the badge lives. It steps aside (and returns after a calm delay) when a tile would be under it; the toolbar clock always shows the same time.

tokens.label: Legend
tokens.doc: What the tile marks mean, generated from the active skin's own legend() so it can never describe a renderer that no longer exists (02-popups.md F-13: 3 of 11 swatches matched).

tokens.label: Overview map
tokens.doc: A small overview of every unit on the field with the viewport box (P-13). Click to fly. It pulses when a card is about something off-screen.

tokens.label: Home
tokens.doc: Where the overview lives. It steps aside for a tile and returns after a calm delay.

tokens.label: Hints
tokens.doc: Short contextual hints (P-38): how to play, step, select, and read the Chronicle. Each shows once and goes when used. Press ? for the full list.

tokens.label: Hint time
tokens.doc: How long a hint stays when nothing is done (wall-clock).

tokens.label: Hints per session
tokens.doc: At most this many hints are shown in a session.

tokens.label: Chronicle
tokens.doc: The strip in the dock that carries the chips and the list of everything that has happened so far (events, stories, command changes). Nothing is ever dropped: a card that finds no room is a chip here.

tokens.label: Include low-significance rows
tokens.doc: List the 3 'low' chronology rows too (they never raise a card).

tokens.label: Rows in the list
tokens.doc: How many of the latest rows the Chronicle list renders (older ones scroll in on request).
